Beijing, Nanjing, Canton, Chengdu, Xian, Wuchang and Mukden all fly our flag. The warlord era is over: proclaim one China. Only the six great cliques and the eight regional states may do so.
With Beijing, Tianjin, Jinan, Kaifeng, Taiyuan in our hands we can proclaim the Beiyang Government. Only Zhili Clique, Anhui Clique, Shandong Military Government, Henan Pacification Zone may do so.
With Canton, Nanning, Guilin in our hands we can proclaim Liangguang. Only Canton Government, Guangxi Clique may do so.
With Chengdu, Chongqing in our hands we can proclaim the State of Shu. Only Sichuan Clique, Chongqing Arsenal State may do so.
With Nanjing, Shanghai, Hangzhou in our hands we can proclaim the State of Wu. Only League of Five Provinces, Zhejiang Republic, Shanghai Free City may do so.
